skills.description: Show how much money you're burning on Claude Code. Use this skill whenever the user wants to check costs, spending, token usage, or billing for their Claude Code sessions. Trigger on /burn, and also when users ask things like "how much did i burn", "what's my burn rate", "what's my usage", "how many tokens", "am I spending too much", or any question about Claude Code session expenses.
